scope: checked enhanced-group construction and inspection; existing STE/STEB V3000 interchange is reused, not newly implemented
base: cac480fb snapshot plus preserved earlier RDKit/Open Babel candidates; this patch adds the checked grouping API

fixture.source: Original small-molecule diagnostic cases authored for this project, following the metadata gap discussed in RDKit issue 9705
fixture.external_data: No upstream attachments, structures or BIOVIA example records copied
fixture.minimization: Two six-carbon dienes isolate correlated bond groups; one seven-atom alcohol isolates atom/bond correlation. Explicit stereochemical SMILES set the drawn configuration.

oracle.name: Source-authored membership and declared configuration; RDKit InChI for drawn geometry only
oracle.version: RDKit 2026.09.1; BIOVIA CTfile Chemistry 2026 collection token definitions
oracle.settings: ABS/AND/OR; explicit native graph atom/bond indices; 24 deterministic atom numberings per kind and structure; no enumeration or group canonicalization oracle

rdkit_reference.note: RDKit is an independent drawn-geometry/InChI reference and a defect diagnostic; its lossy enhanced-group output is not the membership oracle

limits: Group structure only; no automatic stereo perception, inversion, isomer enumeration, canonical enhanced-group identity or new CXSMILES syntax. Same-kind same-number STE/STEB correlation reuses the existing chematic reader convention; BIOVIA examples do not explicitly settle mixed namespace correlation. Plain SMILES and other graph projections do not encode these groups.
